uvp_claim.quote: The caregiving benefit for every employee
We believe no one should go through caregiving alone.

main_features.quote: Our platform combines expert guidance, practical tools, and trusted care options, so employees spend less time searching and stressing, and more time focused at work and present with loved ones.
Once employees fill out the short intake form, they are immediately paired with a Care Coach whose experience matches the employee’s caregiving needs.
Securely upload files or documents for easy accessibility whenever needed by the Care Team.
Our Care Coaches will contact facilities during the search process to ensure that a facility will be a good option for your loved one.
Our Care Coaches have been trained to respond to our members within 2 hours of reaching out through our platform.
Employees can search, compare, book, and pay for care all in one place.

differentiation.quote: We do not accept referral, lead generation, or subscription fees of any kind from any healthcare provider.
We set a new standard for employer-sponsored caregiving benefits that serve employers and their employees through every caregiving journey.

audience.quote: Our Caregiver Support Platform® is designed for the complex realities of working parents and caregivers, offering one easy solution for connection, understanding, and care at every stage.
As part of our offering for employers, we allow employees to create Cases for as many loved ones as they like.
Cariloop provides an innovative and inclusive solution that helps you support and retain valuable employees

price.quote: While the vast majority of our work is done on a per employee per month basis, we also offer our services in blocks of cases.
Typically our minimum size group is 100 employees, but we can configure our program to accommodate groups as small as 50 or 75 as well.

When an employee leaves an organization where Cariloop is part of their benefits or wellness program, a 30-day countdown is triggered within our platform that allows the member to shift to an individual membership that they can cover the cost of on their own.

shared_access.quote: Invite other family members or stakeholders to participate in the case as a part of the “Care Team” (such as the family’s financial advisor, legal counselor, care manager, etc.).
Any time there is activity within a case, every individual who has been invited onto the Care Team will be notified and can actively collaborate with the other Care Team members and their Care Coach.

Anyone who you have granted access to your Case can post discussions and upload documents. Therefore, your siblings can communicate directly with your Care Coach via the portal at any time—no need for you to spend extra time being the mediator.
